summary: Design mobile-channel fraud controls, escalation, and customer-redress workflows. Explore the five-day course and practical curriculum.
lede: Digital financial services fraud prevention training helps operations, fraud and risk, and customer-protection teams manage channel controls. Participants practise assessing fraud scenarios with ISO 31000 and COSO, mapping agent and merchant controls, and defining alert escalation and customer-redress workflows. AI-assisted anomaly triage is introduced at an operational awareness level.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who design, operate, oversee, or review fraud controls for digital financial services, including mobile-money and agent-supported channels.
modules: FMEA for Agent and Merchant Controls
prerequisites: Recommended: working familiarity with digital or mobile financial services operations, fraud controls, risk, compliance, or customer support. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to spreadsheet software if you want to build a digital dashboard prototype; no particular vendor platform is required.
